rows.definition: The pre-load, band-based quant capability census: given a serve backend and the GGUF header's declared weight bands, it decides which quant types that backend can dispatch (resident device kernel or bounded host dequant) and returns one per-band dispatch verdict before any tensor bytes are read.
rows.distinction: It inspects the checkpoint HEADER on the Metal admission path only, before load; it is not the post-load retained-tensor gate LoadQuantCapabilityRefusal, which re-checks the k-quant tensors the loader actually kept after routing.

rows.definition: The post-load quant capability refusal: after a checkpoint has been loaded, it censuses the k-quant tensors the loader retained and refuses the load when a kind has neither a resident device kernel nor a bounded host dequant path, naming every offending kind with its tensor count and byte share.
rows.distinction: It runs on the RETAINED tensor set after load-time routing, on every serve load arm; it is not the pre-load header-band census QuantCapabilityCensus, which gates only the Metal admission path before bytes are read.
